title: Wire Mana's improvement lifecycle: task label, lesson quotes, post-deploy evals
body:
Closes #1407.

- **Task label:** an improvement issue I approve is filed with `mana-task`, so she can pick it up. The label is in the payload I review, so the digest covers it, and the approval summary says so.
- **Lessons in duplicate checks:** her proposals now check her open #1385 lessons. Main still had the "no lessons yet" stub.
- **Lesson quotes:** when an issue runs out of tries, its explanation quotes her lesson: her guess, marked unverified, or else the last observed fact. In `end()` the lesson is now recorded before the end notice, so it exists by the time the lifecycle reads it. A broken lessons store is ignored.
- **Post-deploy evals (`post-deploy-eval.js`):** when her live copy runs a merged PR of hers (the merge commit is an ancestor of HEAD), the behaviour evals run once for that HEAD. They run at below-normal priority with 3 repeats, against the newest passing report.
  - They start only in the 20-minute idle slot, ahead of her own idle pick, and only when she isn't working, no game is running, RAM is under 90% and her chat model is unloaded.
  - A failed gate marks the issue regressed, which holds it, and I get a tray notice. Nothing is reverted.
  - An eval that can't run is retried in later idle periods. After 3 tries she tells me and stops.

Tests: new `post-deploy-eval.test.js` covers one run per deployed HEAD, a failed gate holding the issue, blocked or not-deployed meaning no run, and retries that then tell me. There's a new lifecycle test for the lesson quote, and the proposals test now checks the label.
interface: The merged change for PR #1408 is covered by test/issue-proposals.test.js, test/post-deploy-eval.test.js, test/self-improvement.test.js, test/self-work.test.js.
why: Additional real merged-fix benchmark case selected to broaden the agentic coding evaluation.
